title: Indexing, ranges, cumulative state
overview: A prefix array stores cumulative totals so an interval query becomes a subtraction. An invariant is a property that remains true at each iteration.
invariant: Prefix[0] = 0; prefix[i+1] is the sum of the first i+1 items. A window [l,r] includes both endpoints.
pitfalls: Check off-by-one boundaries, whether the running total is updated, and empty or single-element inputs.
